generation: one fresh fork_turns=none agent per condition-case, one answer per session
model: same inherited default model/reasoning; no override, seed or sampling control

reading_scope.show-me: assigned show-me and prompts only; no Mermaid guide
reading_scope.mermaid-diagrams: assigned Mermaid guide, its references, prompts
reading_scope.visual-v041: assigned visual guide, optional available Mermaid guide/references, prompts

design: compare model knowledge plus show-me against Mermaid guidance and current combined entry; resource access intentionally differs to answer whether show-me alone is enough
filesystem: shared filesystem with instruction-limited access, not OS isolation
review: source-hidden independent review then root checks
limits: two complex synthetic cases, no repetition
